verdict.rationale: Mastra's first-party memory docs say agents can store message history and remember user messages, agent replies and tool results across interactions, recalling information from previous interactions. Threads are a first-class concept, including multi-user threads. missing for 10: explicit evidence that memory is shared or recalled across different threads (e.g. resource-scoped or semantic recall), details of the persistent storage backends behind memory, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
